scripts.dev: npm run assets && npm run dev -w client
scripts.dev:all: npm run assets && concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w tools && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
